title: Grilled Fish Tikka Skewers
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish featuring marinated fish skewers grilled to perfection. This recipe combines the bold flavors of cumin and coriander with the heat of cayenne pepper, all while maintaining a smoky and hearty tone.

ingredients.name: Fish (any firm white fish, cut into 1-inch cubes)

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine yogurt, lime juice, ginger paste, garlic paste, cumin powder, coriander powder, and cayenne pepper. Blend until smooth.
2. Add the fish cubes to the marinade and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Thread the marinated fish cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through and slightly charred.
7. Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as basmati rice or naan bread.
